data.narrative:
Picogrid is a Series A defense and security company that has raised $45M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies—8 private and 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS)—including comparable-stage references to Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $45M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, yielding $90M. Peer-median analysis of the 10-company comp set produces a $1.0B median valuation, with a range spanning $125M (low) to $3.0B (high). Named peers at Series B include Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B).

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $76M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $545M. The wide dispersion—reflecting heterogeneity in defense-tech funding and exit trajectories—underscores two material uncertainties: Picogrid's specific technical differentiation relative to the peer cohort, and whether downstream defense procurement capture will materialize at scale. Stage-progression alone suggests conservatism versus peer medians, warranting credence to the mid-to-upper range pending commercial traction validation.
